_note: Machine side of rules/RULES.md. triggers = regex (case-insensitive) on the words spoken in a shot + its 'scene' text; helper = a call the shot code must contain (any one of them). Rules without triggers are checked by eye (listed by --plan for every shot).

rules.name: Every hit leaves a mark
rules.must: flash -> breach/chunks burst out -> rubble falls -> dust lingers 2-3 s -> camera shake

rules.name: Damage stays
rules.must: later shots in the same set show the hole, thin smoke, rubble

rules.name: Character size
rules.must: hero within 5% of adult height incl. hair (a lineup shot: roles side by side, print ch.headWorld().y)

rules.name: HUD inside frame
rules.must: the clock pill over the head is fully inside the frame

rules.name: No lip-sync on narration
rules.must: only the speaking character moves its mouth

rules.name: Flying reads as flying
rules.must: gap under the feet, small far shadow, hair/cloth flutter, bob
